messages:
sasha: Heads-up — I'm starting staged bring-up for rwd-ggml-v5 (float->nf4 hybrid) on staging now. Want a short concordance + safety checklist before we open fractional traffic.
hao: 👍 what's the baseline we're comparing to? rwd-ggml-v4? or the hosted-prod model?
sasha: baseline = prod: rwd-v3.2 (int8). Primary checks: 1) top-1 semantic concordance on eval set, 2) hallucination rate on safety slices, 3) latency p95 and token-cost delta.
mira: For concordance let's run slice-wise BLEU/ROUGE-ish + embedding cosine on the benchmark corpus. also run the controlled prompt halluc test (safety_suites/v2).
sam: Can we also surface delta on structured-output fidelity? Last time a quant change broke JSON outputs for some templates.
jules: echo miras note — add schema-parse success rate (>=99.5% target) and response-length distribution (no >2x tail increase).
sasha: here's the quick rollout config I'm going to use, feedback pls:
```
rollout:
  id: rwdv5-staged-2026-03-20
  phases:
    - name: smoke
      pct: 0.1
      duration: 30m
    - name: burn
      pct: 2
      duration: 3h
  auto_fallback:
    metrics:
      - name: concordance_top1_delta
        threshold: -0.015  # fail if >1.5% relative regression
      - name: hallucination_rate
        threshold: 0.02    # absolute
      - name: p95_latency_ms
        threshold: 80      # absolute ms
    window: 15m
```
hao: thresholds look reasonable. Suggest: make concordance delta relative to baseline with a per-slice override for high-variance slices (e.g., legal/finance tighter).
mira: agree — add per-slice windows and require sample size >= 500 for a slice to be enforced or else ignore for auto-fallback.
ml-oncall: +1 on sample-size guard. Also add a soft-alert for token-cost uptick >10% so we can triage before a rollback.
sam: How are we measuring hallucination_rate? previous was a mix of rule-based and annotator sample. we need a quick proxy for staging: entailment model threshold + keyword anchors.
sasha: good call. For staging use entailment proxy (sent-scoring model v2) + a small manual spot-check of 200 examples from safety slices. If entailment proxy signals >2% regress vs baseline -> fallback.
devops-bot: deploy event: rwd-ggml-v5 staging cluster created (cluster-stg-49). image: rwd-ggml-v5:20260320-nf4 hybrid. started 430123-430124.
jules: quick checklist before we flip smoke: 1) smoke QA pass (manual) 2) concordance run kicked and baseline loaded 3) metrics alarms wired to rollout policy + slack notify channel 4) shadow traffic run completed.
sasha: doing shadow run now, kicking concordance job `eval/onboard/concordance-stg-rwdv5` — will post results in ~25m.
hao: If shadow shows 0.5-1.0% concordance uplift but cost +8%, can we proceed to burn? what's the company tolerance?
mira: Product alignment: cost uptick <=12% is acceptable if concordance uplift >0.8% and hallucination_rate not worse.
sam: note: if structured-output drift >0.2% we never promote; that's mandatory rollback.
sasha: noted. I'll update rollout config with per-slice overrides and sample-size guards. will report back with concordance run and a short sample of failures.
ml-oncall: I'm on-call for the next 6h — ping me if auto-fallback trips or we see >0.5% steady-state hallucination increase.
sasha: thanks all — running now. will post `---results---` message when done.
